capabilities: browse the vault as a folder/tag tree with a cover-image card wall
search notes and PDFs with a built-in BM25 full-text index
preview images in a Quick Look-style peek with share and copy actions
render bare URLs as rich link preview cards
reorder, recolor, hide and batch-move folders and cards
disambiguation: Not just an image-gallery viewer; it is a full vault navigator whose cards cover notes, PDFs, Canvas and Base files, and web links.
extras: Includes a detailed network-use and file-access disclosure (link metadata fetches, favicon service, optional Instagram oEmbed calls; no telemetry). Not yet in the community store; install manually or via BRAT. Settings and caches from the absorbed standalone plugins are not migrated.
intentEvidence: Both of my earlier standalone plugins are now built into Gallery Navigator as the Image peek and Link cards modules.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file explorer is a text list, which makes browsing image-heavy or visual collections hard to scan.

relations.evidence: Coming from Image Peek or Link Card Preview? Disable them first.

summary: Visual file navigator that replaces the file list with a folder/tag tree and a masonry wall of cover-image cards for notes, images, PDFs, Canvas and links.
